description: List the values of an Art Institute of Chicago collection vocabulary with how many artworks carry each, most common first, optionally narrowed by a substring. Each value passes to the artic_search_artworks filter of the same name exactly as listed (case is ignored). Counts here span the whole collection; for counts within a filtered set of artworks, request facets from artic_search_artworks.

contains.description: Case- and accent-insensitive substring the values must contain, such as "impress" for Impressionism and Post-Impressionism, or "applique" for appliqué (technique). Omit to list the most common values.

limit.description: Values to return, most common first (1-100).

vocabulary.description: Vocabulary to list; its values feed the artic_search_artworks filter of the same name.

name: artic_lookup_vocabulary

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `rate_limited`: The Art Institute API throttled this server and retries ran out, or the shared request queue could not start the call in time. `request_blocked`: The Art Institute API's firewall blocked the request, as it does for markup or script-like text and for bursts of traffic. `upstream_rejected_query`: The Art Institute API rejected a request this server built from valid inputs. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filter_param.description: The artic_search_artworks parameter that accepts these values as listed.

notice.description: Guidance when no value matched or the list was capped.

truncated.description: True when more values exist beyond the limit.

items.description: One vocabulary value and its artwork count.

value.description: Value as the index stores it (place values are lower-case without accents); pass it back verbatim.

title: Look up collection vocabulary
